deviations: livemix::flush_denormal on the eight one-pole filter states (no flush-to-zero in WASM)

source.note: SpectralDrifter.h/.cpp are kkfonie's Bloom drifter with the JUCE references replaced and denormal flushes added; the algorithm and constants are unchanged. spectral_drifter_device.* and device_api.cpp are live-mix host code: one drifter per channel, Bloom's equal-power mix and 5 ms bloom ramp, Bloom's per-line age tracker (PluginProcessor.cpp:323-343) run on the input or a manual age, and the ABI. Bloom's 25 % drift re-injection into its FDN loop is not reproduced (an insert has no loop).
